To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
herbicides can affect soil microbial community structure, but not always their activity.
the effect of herbicide mixture on soil microbial respiration is soil dependent and the effect on the bacterial diversity is soil and herbicide dependent.
herbicide mixtures can affect the bacterial diversity in soil, but not the soil biological activity, as evaluated by 14CO2 release.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a better understanding of the effects of herbicides alone and in mixtures upon soil biological activity, and the bacterial diversity and structure.
a new approach of herbicide mixtures, showing that the herbicide mix application may have a different effect in different soil types.
the effects of herbicides and their mixture on carbon transformation and bacterial diversity in two Brazilian soils.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

diuron, sulfometuron-metyl and hexazinon did not cause any significant changes in the respiration rate of microorganisms in both soils, but they caused changes in the bacterial diversity in the two soil types.
the herbicide mixture affected the bacterial diversity, however the respiration induced by substrate was not affected.
the effect of the herbicide mix applied on bacterial diversity and respiration rate is soil dependent.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

herbicides did not affect soil microbial activity measured by the 14CO2 production, but they affected the bacterial diversity and structure in both soils, with different herbicide effects depending on soil texture.
diuron and sulfomethuron-methyl affected the bacterial diversity and the mixture of the three herbicides had the greatest effect.
herbicides did not affect the carbon mineralization rate, but affected the bacterial diversity and structure in both soils.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the herbicide mix application did not affect soil respiration but affected the bacterial diversity.
the herbicides used in this study, alone or in mixture, affected the bacterial diversity and structure of the soil microbial community, which could lead to changes in the soil microbial activity.
the herbicide mixture did not affect the bacterial diversity in clayey soil.
